neighbours.label: garments in casual/menswear lists of trousers and shirts (khakis, slacks, polos), the side opposed to dresses and gowns on the - pole
fire: For the office, wear pressed khakis and a collared shirt rather than jeans.
He packed two pairs of chinos, a polo shirt and a light sweater.
The dress code asks men for slacks and a button-down shirt.
She paired wide-leg trousers with a crisp white blouse.
Cargo pants and a fleece jacket are best for the hike.
Most staff wore dark trousers and short-sleeved polos in the summer.
The shop sells corduroy pants, flannel shirts and wool vests.
Choose tailored trousers and a blazer for the business dinner.
quiet: For the gala, wear a long silk evening gown rather than a cocktail dress.
She packed two sundresses, a nightgown and a light shawl.
The bridesmaids all wore floor-length chiffon dresses.
She paired a lace wedding gown with a long veil.
A cotton nightdress and a bathrobe are best for the hospital stay.
Most guests wore ball gowns and long gloves at the dance.
The shop sells prom dresses, bridal gowns and evening wraps.
Choose a knee-length dress and pearls for the garden party.

notes: Top: khaki trousers, casual slacks, polo shirts, sleeve details; - pole is gowns, night shirts, dresses. Output promotes ' pant', ' layers', ' hem', suppresses ' gown', ' dress'. Near misses keep clothing but are dresses/gowns.
